assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and persistent dizziness, raising concern for an underlying arrhythmic etiology.
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks.

Long-term continuous ECG monitoring (CPT 93247) is indicated to evaluate for intermittent conduction abnormalities or atrial fibrillation by correlating symptoms with cardiac rhythm over an extended period.
The service is documented in the indication note.
The claim was denied under Reason Code PR-204.
The denial is inconsistent with the patient's documented symptoms of syncope, dizziness, and transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
CPT code 93247 represents a long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study.
